run.name: Clear Channel Outdoor Holdings, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (CCO)
run.summary: Clear Channel Outdoor is a highly leveraged advertiser whose earnings are improving while its debt is unchanged. Debt is 9.46x trailing Adjusted EBITDA and cash interest cover is 1.40x, with a take-private merger still pending. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal 5,148.8 (S4 page:15) over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 544.3 (C1); net of continuing cash 192.1 (S4 page:2). Calculated, C3. Adjusted EBITDA is issuer non-GAAP; operating leases excluded; Spain sale proceeds not reflected

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 544.3 over LTM cash paid for interest 390.1 (C2). Calculated, C4. The prepayment interest falls in both FY2025 and H1 2025 and so nets out of the LTM figure; cash interest still comes from a statement that includes discontinued operations

cash.basis: Cash. Cash of continuing operations (S4 page:2); 10.1 held in discontinued operations excluded (S4 page:10). Availability as printed in total (S4 page:33); the two facility figures of 93.0 and 112.4 sum to 205.4 and the filing attributes the difference to rounding (S4 page:34). The revolver letter of credit of 7.0 related to Spain and was cancelled on August 4, 2026 (S4 page:34)

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Nothing after August 5, 2026 is supplied, and the executed debt documents, guarantor list and ownership table are not.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is the issuer's own measure, and balances are at June 30, 2026 with the merger still pending.
